description: Guardrails for the CoreBank servicing console. Origins are the three tenant instances of the same vendor product.

irreversible.description: Commits a new record (account opening, application submission). Deliberately broad and keyed on the control's name: an unrecognised commit button should stop and ask, not proceed.

mutating.description: Writes new contact details onto the member record. Changes real data, but the previous values are on the form and can be typed back — which is exactly what separates mutating from irreversible. Keyed on the control name ALONE and not on the route: this product is a <frameset>, so the surface's location is the frameset shell and a routePattern would never match. See REPORT.md section 6.
Types into a field. Changes client state only until submitted.
